Name: Ad Astra - Per Stardew
Author: MagicianFlea
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5]Ad Astra, Per Stardew [/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]is an expansion mod aiming to bring the quiet world of Stardew Valley to a place it rarely goes: the world of science fiction! 

[u]As of now it contains:[/u]

8 New crops!
2 New sapling!
3 New animals and their related products!
2 New NPCs:
﻿Juno, the Linguist, who is in the valley for clandestine reasons.
﻿A hidden character, revealed at the end of the new dungeon
4 New locations!
A Brand New Dungeon, which can be accessed from the Secluded Outpost! (You will need to unlock the quarry first!)[/size][/font]
[font=Arial][size=3]Another New Dungeon!
A New hidden shop!
12 New Recipes!
8 New Weapons! (Some currently Unobtainable, will be available in final version. Can be debugged in)
9 New Fish!

With plenty more to come! 

[u]Look forward to the following in the future:[/u]

Several more new animals!
Several more new crops!
A few more NPCs! 
A new Greenhouse!
A new tool!

And likely more!

This mod should be compatible with all others, but please let me know if you experience any issues with cross mod compatibility. It does not change much about the vanilla game, mostly adding new areas, so it shouldn't affect them greatly, however, Juno may damage items in the Quarry with her pathing. I am working on a change to her routine to fix this. [/size]
[/font]
[font=Arial][size=3]I am a solo dev with... minimal experience in computer science and even less experience in Stardew modding[/size][/font],[font=Arial][size=3] but I am really enjoying the process of making this mod and I hope to make it as exciting and fun as it is in my mind![/size]

[/font]

Downloads.Description: Several needed bug fixes and changes to the way that characters and areas are introduced. This is being released a bit before I feel it is entirely ready to be the next big update, mostly to address concerns from some users.

Manifest.Name: Ad Astra, Per Stardew
Manifest.Description: Something is buried deep in the mountains, a secret which may reveal the past. Or pave the way for the future?
